rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for frozen water.

example.english: I want ice in my lemon tea.
example.jyutping: bui1 dung3 ling4 caa4 jap6 min6 jiu3 gaa1 bing1

rows.note: Use 冷場 for an awkward or dead atmosphere that blocks conversation, especially in a ‘break the ice’ situation.

example.english: No one said a word, and the whole party suddenly became so awkward that it was hard to break the ice.
example.traditional: 突然冇人出聲，成個聚會即刻冷場。
example.jyutping: dat6 jin4 mou5 jan4 ceot1 seng1 sing4 go3 zeoi6 wui2 zik1 hak1 laang5 coeng4

rows.note: Use this fixed noun phrase for an unfeeling heart or person, rather than for literal coldness.

example.english: They ignore even stray cats; they really have a heart of ice.
example.traditional: 佢見到流浪貓都唔理，真係鐵石心腸。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gin3 dou2 lau4 long6 maau1 dou1 m4 lei5 zan1 hai6 tit3 sek6 sam1 coeng4
